acceptance_criteria: Invalid combos return invalidProperties; bodyValues read and used when partId present; tests cover mutual-exclusivity and single-text/html-part rules
description: RFC 8621 §4.6 defines strict rules for email creation: (1) bodyStructure and textBody/htmlBody/attachments are mutually exclusive — if bodyStructure is present, the other three MUST NOT be; (2) if textBody is given, it must contain exactly one part of type text/plain; (3) if htmlBody is given, exactly one part of type text/html; (4) within EmailBodyPart, client may specify partId OR blobId but not both; (5) bodyValues (map from partId to EmailBodyValue) must be parsed and used to supply body content for parts with partId. Currently handle_email_set (email.rs lines 461–660) calls build_email_from_create without any of this validation. The bodyValues field is not read at all.
title: Email/set create: validate bodyStructure and parse bodyValues
